scope: Bounded PostgreSQL connection-setting and TLS credential preparation; no DNS, TLS handshake, PostgreSQL session, migration or durable outcome claim

source.state: isolated branch candidate before containing commit

environment.private_fixture_policy: Tests generate synthetic private keys inside owned temporary directories and retain no key artifact in Git or evidence

input_policy.meaning: Application preparation caps chosen for bounded work, not measured PostgreSQL protocol maxima
input_policy.accounting_limit: The exposed cap-plus-one reservation and observed source-byte sum omit rustls/Config copies, vector capacities and allocator overhead; consumers retain a separate conservative process charge through the driver lifetime

implemented: Owned tokio-postgres Config with exact password bytes, explicit finite connect timeout and explicit TLS require/disable mode
Verify-full connector with only configured CA roots, explicit ring provider and an expected-name wrapper over upstream MakeRustlsConnect
Optional client certificate/key pair parsed from protected files and checked by rustls for a usable matching identity
Public CA descriptor walk refuses final and parent symlinks, special files and cap overflow without imposing private-key permissions
Plaintext accepts only lexical loopback or single-label private-bridge settings and retains the declared boundary for later resolved-address vetting/pinning
Static redacted errors and Debug implementations omit endpoints, users, database names, paths, password bytes and upstream parser text

executed.command: CARGO_HOME=$PWD/.research/cargo-home CARGO_TARGET_DIR=$PWD/.research/target cargo test --locked -p bigbrotr --test postgres_connection_settings
executed.scope: Real ephemeral X.509/key parsing, match/mismatch, paired inputs, CA descriptor/size failures, exact password bytes, plaintext boundary and redaction

executed.command: CARGO_HOME=$PWD/.research/cargo-home cargo deny --manifest-path Cargo.toml check advisories licenses sources
RUSTDOCFLAGS=-D warnings CARGO_HOME=$PWD/.research/cargo-home CARGO_TARGET_DIR=$PWD/.research/target cargo doc --locked --workspace --no-deps

executed.scope: Links, JSON, fences and selected evidence hashes only

license_review.scope: Exact published source notices are recorded in the dependency contract; final binary/image notice aggregation and complete SBOM remain release work

counterexamples_fixed: Unpaired client identity now fails before opening an otherwise missing password
A lexical plaintext hostname cannot certify its resolved route, so the transport retains the boundary for the connected owner to vet and pin hostaddr
Final and parent CA symlinks are both refused through descriptor-relative no-follow traversal
Mismatched real client certificate/private key and multiple private keys fail during preparation
No synthetic private key is checked in or retained as evidence

not_run: Actual PostgreSQL DNS/address vetting and hostaddr pinning
TLS handshake against correct and wrong CA/server names, client-certificate authentication and channel binding
PostgreSQL authentication, server/version/read-only inspection, statement and lock deadlines
Connection-task join/cancellation, ambiguous COMMIT resolution and migration privileges
Native Linux amd64/arm64 execution and packaged credential mounts
